mentions.name: Roomba stair lift
mentions.description: A stair lift for a Roomba robot vacuum that fits into a small box and can be retrofitted onto any stairs, letting the vacuum travel between floors on its own. It also carries laundry up and down the stairs.
mentions.problem: The author got tired of carrying the robot vacuum up and down stairs manually and didn't want to buy a separate vacuum for each floor.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm making a stair lift for my Roomba. It fits into a small box and you can retrofit it on any stairs.
